---

Key finding already: the widget’s timeline *tries* to refresh every 15 minutes and even fetches from the server itself — but it **never uses `authorizationToken` from `SharedWidgetConfig`**. If the server now requires auth (or returns different data unauthenticated), the fetch will fail and the widget will fall back to cached data, which only changes when the app runs. Next I’ll confirm the API client supports auth and whether the app writes fresher data when active.

$0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\\\\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\\\\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            dict[deviceID] = dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict\\\\n        precomputedNearbyDevices = computeNearbyGroups(from: dict)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n coordinate)\\\\n        if nearby.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n            devicePickerData = DevicePickerData(devices: nearby)\\\\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\\\\n coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\\\\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\\\\n                return (known, cached)\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\\\\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\\\\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\\\\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\\\\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\\\\n                now = Date() // Update time currentMapSpan\\\\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\\\\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading) but animate map centerCoordinate: coordinate,\\\\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\\\\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\\\\n MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        }\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_url_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server URL is invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server response\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_response_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server response was invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Encoding error: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Error processing the response: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server response.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .requestFailed(_):\\\\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n showNetworkErrorIcon = false\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"error_loading_locationdata\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error loading location data\\\\\\\"))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\\\\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\\\\n        guard interval }\\\\n\\\\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\\\\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\\\\n        debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error: \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\\\\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\\\\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict\\\\n        precomputedNearbyDevices = computeNearbyGroups(from: dict)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func presentActions(for deviceID: String) {\\\\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\\\\n        showDevicePicker = false\\\\n        showDeviceActionDialog = true\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\\\\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @ViewBuilder\\\\n    private func updateButton() -&amp;amp;gt; some View {\\\\n        // Button to manually update device location\\\\n        Button {\\\\n            withAnimation {\\\\n                isUpdating = true\\\\n            }\\\\n            Task {\\\\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    isUpdating = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } label: {\\\\n .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"refresh_location\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Refresh the device location now\\\\\\\")))\\\\n Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: isLoading = true\\\\n        defer {\\\\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\\\\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\\\\n            if remaining &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n immediately\\\\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\\\\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\\\\n                    for: deviceID,\\\\n refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\\\\n                if coordinateChanged {\\\\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\\\\n             }\\\\n                        } else {\\\\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\\\\n                                // On manual update: use zoom level from settings\\\\n showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_url_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server URL is invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server response\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_response_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server response was invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Encoding error: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Error processing the response: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server response.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .requestFailed(_):\\\\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    showNetworkErrorIcon = true\\\\n                }\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {\\\\n                    withAnimation {\\\\n                        showNetworkErrorIcon = false\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, &amp;amp;gt; 0 else { return }\\\\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\\\\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @ViewBuilder\\\\n    private func updateButton() -&amp;amp;gt; some View {\\\\n        // Button to manually update device location\\\\n        Button {\\\\n            withAnimation {\\\\n                isUpdating = true\\\\n            }\\\\n            Task {\\\\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    isUpdating = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } label: {\\\\n .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"refresh_location\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Refresh the device location now\\\\\\\")))\\\\n        .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"refresh_location_hint\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Fetches the latest location and resets zoom if configured\\\\\\\")))\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !deviceID.isEmpty else {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL or DeviceID\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n        let minShimmerDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5\\\\n        let startTime = Date()\\\\n        isLoading = true\\\\n        defer {\\\\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\\\\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\\\\n            if remaining &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\\\\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || immediately\\\\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\\\\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\\\\n                    for: deviceID,\\\\n refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\\\\n                if coordinateChanged {\\\\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\\\\n                    isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.2)) {\\\\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\\\\n                            if movement\\\\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\\\\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\\\\n MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        }\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_url_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server URL is invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Encoding error: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Error processing the response: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server response.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .requestFailed(_):\\\\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\\\\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\\\\n        guard interval &amp;amp;gt; 0 else { return }\\\\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\\\\n nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n currentItem else { return }\\\\n                self.precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = currentItem\\\\n longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\\\\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\\\\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord\\\\n        }\\\\n        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {\\\\n            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {\\\\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Avoid redundant recomputation if coordinates have not changed\\\\n        if coordinatesEqual(lhs:    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)\\\\n        if nearby.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\\\\n            showDevicePicker = true\\\\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\\\\n            presentActions(for: first.DeviceID)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            presentActions(for: deviceID)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\\\\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\\\\n                return (known, cached)\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n        let currentItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async { [currentItem] in\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, active === currentItem else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = currentItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: currentItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\\\\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @ViewBuilder\\\\n    private func Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !deviceID.isEmpty else {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL or DeviceID\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n        let minShimmerDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5\\\\n        let startTime = Date()\\\\n        isLoading = true\\\\n        defer {\\\\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\\\\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\\\\n            if remaining &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\\\\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\\\\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\\\\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\\\\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\\\\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\\\\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\\\\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\\\\n                    for: deviceID,\\\\n                    batteryLevel: loc.BatteryLevel,\\\\n                    altitude: loc.Altitude,\\\\n                    speed: loc.Speed\\\\n                )\\\\n                refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\\\\n                if coordinateChanged {\\\\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\\\\n                    isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.2)) {\\\\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\\\\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\\\\n                                // On manual update: realign map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\\\\n                                let northCamera = MapCamera(centerCoordinate: coordinate, distance: currentMapCamera?.distance ?? 1000, heading: 0, pitch: currentMapCamera?.pitch ?? 0)\\\\n                                cameraPosition = .camera(northCamera)\\\\n                                currentMapSpan = settingsSpan // Also update currentMapSpan\\\\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\\\\n                                // On automatic update: keep current orientation (heading) but animate map movement\\\\n                                if let currentCamera = currentMapCamera {\\\\n                                    let newCamera = MapCamera(\\\\n                                        centerCoordinate: coordinate,\\\\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\\\\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\\\\n                                        pitch: currentCamera.pitch\\\\n                                    )\\\\n                                    cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\\\\n                                } else {\\\\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentMapSpan))\\\\n                                }\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        } else {\\\\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\\\\n                                // On manual update: use zoom level from settings\\\\n                                let settingsSpan = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\\\\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: settingsSpan)\\\\n                            } else if isAutoCenteringEnabled {\\\\n                                // On automatic update: keep current zoom level but animate map movement\\\\n                                let currentZoomLevel = currentZoomLevelFromSpan(region.span)\\\\n                                let currentSpan = spanForZoomLevel(currentZoomLevel)\\\\n                                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        }\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"No location data found\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"no_location_data_found\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"No location available\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch let error as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\\\\n            // Differentiated error handling\\\\n            switch error {\\\\n            case .invalidURL:\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server URL\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_url_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server URL is invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .invalidResponse(_):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server response\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_response_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server response was invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Encoding error: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Error processing the response: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server response.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .requestFailed(_):\\\\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    showNetworkErrorIcon = true\\\\n                }\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {\\\\n                    withAnimation {\\\\n                        showNetworkErrorIcon = false\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"error_loading_locationdata\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error loading location data\\\\\\\"))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\\\\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\\\\n        guard interval &amp;amp;gt; 0 else { return }\\\\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\\\\n            }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\\\\n        timerCancellable = nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        startAutoUpdate()\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\\\\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\\\\n        debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error: \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\\\\n coordinate,\\\\n            distance: currentCamera.distance,\\\\n            heading: 0, // North\\\\n            pitch: currentCamera.pitch\\\\n        )\\\\n        // iPad-specific: Enhanced compass alignment animation\\\\n        beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\\\\n        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\\\\n            cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\\\\n            userHasRotatedMap = false // Hide compass when aligned to north\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Resets the map zoom to the value from settings\\\\n    private func #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\\\\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\\\\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\\\\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\\\\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\\\\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\\\\n                currentMapSpan = span\\\\n            }\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\\\\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\\\\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\\\\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\\\\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\\\\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\\\\n        guard let region = region else deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n        for other in others {\\\\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\\\\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\\\\n                    count += 1\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#Preview {\\\\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \\\\\\\"Test Device\\\\\\\", deviceID: }\\\\n\\\\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\\\\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\\\\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n cachedDeviceCoordinates, rhs: dict) {\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n        cachedDeviceCoordinates = dict\\\\n        scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with: dict)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)\\\\n        if nearby.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\\\\n            showDevicePicker = true\\\\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\\\\n String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\\\\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\\\\n                return (known, cached)\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\\\\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @ViewBuilder\\\\n    private func updateButton() -&amp;amp;gt; some View {\\\\n        // Button to manually update device location\\\\n        Button {\\\\n            withAnimation {\\\\n                isUpdating = true\\\\n            }\\\\n            Task {\\\\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    isUpdating = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } label: {\\\\n .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"refresh_location\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Refresh the device location now\\\\\\\")))\\\\n        .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"refresh_location_hint\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Fetches the latest location and resets zoom if configured\\\\\\\")))\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: comment: \\\\\\\"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n        let minShimmerDuration: TimeInterval = 1.5\\\\n        let startTime = Date()\\\\n        isLoading = true\\\\n        defer {\\\\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\\\\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\\\\n            if remaining &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n  forDeviceIDs: [deviceID],\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            if let loc = locations.first {\\\\n                let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: loc.Latitude, longitude: loc.Longitude)\\\\n                let coordinateChanged = deviceLocation?.latitude != coordinate.latitude || deviceLocation?.longitude != coordinate.longitude\\\\n                deviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                // Update animated location immediately to ensure marker moves\\\\n                animatedDeviceLocation = coordinate\\\\n                deviceAccuracy = loc.HorizontalAccuracy\\\\n                deviceTimestamp = loc.TimestampDate\\\\n                now = Date() // Update time immediately\\\\n                // Cache the new location including optional speed\\\\n                DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\\\\n                    for: deviceID,\\\\n refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates()\\\\n                if coordinateChanged {\\\\n                    // iPad-specific: Enhanced location change animations with explicit map movement\\\\n                    isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.2)) {\\\\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\\\\n                            if spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\\\\n                                let northCamera = MapCamera(centerCoordinate: coordinate, distance: currentMapCamera?.distance ?? 1000, heading: 0, pitch: centerCoordinate: coordinate,\\\\n                                        distance: currentCamera.distance,\\\\n                                        heading: currentCamera.heading,\\\\n        } else {\\\\n                                    cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentMapSpan))\\\\n                                }\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        } else {\\\\n                            if resetZoomToSettings {\\\\n                                // On manual update: use zoom level from settings\\\\n MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentSpan)\\\\n                            }\\\\n                        }\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n                showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Encoding error: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Error processing the response: \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server showNetworkErrorIcon = false\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"error_loading_locationdata\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error loading location data\\\\\\\"))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\\\\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\\\\n        guard interval &amp;amp;gt; 0 else { return }\\\\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\\\\n coordinate)\\\\n        if nearby.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\\\\n            showDevicePicker = true\\\\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\\\\n            presentActions(for: first.DeviceID)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            presentActions(for: deviceID)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        // Only consider devices that already have cached coordinates (i.e., shown/eligible as annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        guard let _ = cachedDeviceCoordinates[deviceID] else {\\\\n            return []\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n        isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\\\\n        // Add generous grace period to cover chained animations and MapKit internal settling\\\\n        suppressUserCameraChangeDetectionUntil = Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.2, duration + 1.35))\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @ViewBuilder\\\\n    private func updateButton() -&amp;amp;gt; some View {\\\\n        // Button to manually update device location\\\\n        Button {\\\\n            withAnimation {\\\\n                isUpdating = true\\\\n            }\\\\n            Task {\\\\n                await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n                    isUpdating = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } label: {\\\\n Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: isLoading = true\\\\n        defer {\\\\n            let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)\\\\n            let remaining = minShimmerDuration - elapsed\\\\n            if remaining &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + remaining) {\\\\n                    isLoading = false\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        // Only consider devices that already have cached coordinates (i.e., shown/eligible as annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        var devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate)\\\\n        if nearby.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n            nearbyDevicesForPicker = nearby\\\\n            showDevicePicker = true\\\\n        } else if let first = nearby.first {\\\\n String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        // Only consider devices that already have cached coordinates (i.e., shown/eligible as annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        var devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n deviceLookup[deviceID] {\\\\n            devicesWithCoordinates.append((tappedDevice, coordinate))\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Programmatic animation helper\\\\n    private func beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: Double) {\\\\n Fetches the latest location for the device from the server\\\\n    private func fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n response.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case .requestFailed(_):\\\\n                // Show only the network error icon, not the overlay\\\\n                withAnimation {\\\\n others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func presentActions(for deviceID: String) {\\\\n        selectedActionDeviceID = deviceID\\\\n        showDevicePicker = false\\\\n        showDeviceActionDialog = true\\\\n cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\\\\n                return (known, cached)\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\\\\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\\\\n        debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error: WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\""

Double\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    func encode(with aCoder: NSCoder) {\\\\n        aCoder.encode(deviceID, forKey: \\\\\\\"deviceID\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(latitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"latitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(longitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"longitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(accuracy, forKey: \\\\\\\"accuracy\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(timestamp, forKey: \\\\\\\"timestamp\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(country, forKey: \\\\\\\"country\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(locality, forKey: \\\\\\\"locality\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(timeZone?.identifier, forKey: \\\\\\\"timeZoneIdentifier\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(batteryLevel, forKey: \\\\\\\"batteryLevel\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(altitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"altitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(speed, forKey: \\\\\\\"speed\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    static var supportsSecureCoding: Bool {\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nclass DeviceLocationCacheStore: ObservableObject {\\\\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationCacheStore()\\\\n    \\\\n    @Published var locations: [CachedDeviceLocation] = [] {\\\\n        didSet {\\\\n            save()\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    private let fileName = \\\\\\\"deviceLocations.plist\\\\\\\"\\\\n    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()\\\\n    private var geocodeQueue: [String] = []\\\\n    private var isProcessingGeocode: Bool = false\\\\n    private var geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters: CLLocationDistance {\\\\n        CLLocationDistance(SettingsManager.shared.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private var fileURL: URL {\\\\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private init() {\\\\n        self.locations = load()\\\\n        // Enqueue reverse geocoding for any cached entries missing placemarks or timezone\\\\n        for loc in locations where (loc.country == nil &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\\\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\\\\n        do {\\\\n            if let locations = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, CachedDeviceLocation.self, NSDate.self, NSString.self], from: data) as? [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\\\n                return locations\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error loading device locations: \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            // Remove incompatible cache file to prevent repeated load failures\\\\n            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return []\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func setLocation(for deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\\\\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\\\\n            let existing = locations[idx]\\\\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\\\\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\\\\n                deviceID: deviceID,\\\\n                latitude: latitude,\\\\n                longitude: longitude,\\\\n                accuracy: accuracy,\\\\n                timestamp: timestamp,\\\\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\\\\n                country: existing.country,\\\\n                locality: existing.locality,\\\\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\\\\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\\\\n                altitude: altitude,\\\\n                speed: speed ?? existing.speed\\\\n            )\\\\n            locations[idx] = updated\\\\n            if moved {\\\\n                // Re-geocode only on significant movement or if no placemark exists yet\\\\n                let hasPlacemark = (existing.country != nil) || (existing.locality != nil)\\\\n                let oldLoc = CLLocation(latitude: existing.latitude, longitude: existing.longitude)\\\\n                let newLoc = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)\\\\n                let distance = oldLoc.distance(from: newLoc)\\\\n                if !hasPlacemark || distance &amp;amp;gt;= geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters {\\\\n                    enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID, force: true)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            locations.append(CachedDeviceLocation(deviceID: deviceID, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: accuracy, timestamp: timestamp, batteryLevel: batteryLevel, altitude: altitude, speed: speed))\\\\n            // New entry: if no placemark present, enqueue\\\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID)\\\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func getLocation(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CachedDeviceLocation? {\\\\n        return locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID })\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func getPlacemark(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; (country: String?, locality: String?)? {\\\\n        guard let loc = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) else { return nil }\\\\n        return (loc.country, loc.locality)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func setPlacemark(for deviceID: String, country: String?, locality: String?, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil) {\\\\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\\\\n            let loc = locations[idx]\\\\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\\\\n                deviceID: loc.deviceID,\\\\n                latitude: loc.latitude,\\\\n                longitude: loc.longitude,\\\\n                accuracy: loc.accuracy,\\\\n                timestamp: loc.timestamp,\\\\n                country: country,\\\\n                locality: locality,\\\\n                timeZone: timeZone ?? loc.timeZone,\\\\n                batteryLevel: loc.batteryLevel,\\\\n                altitude: loc.altitude\\\\n            )\\\\n            locations[idx] = updated\\\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    func removeLocation(for deviceID: String) {\\\\n        locations.removeAll { $0.deviceID == deviceID }\\\\n        WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Reverse Geocoding Queue\\\\n    func enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for deviceID: String, force: Bool = false) {\\\\n        // If not forced and placemark already present with timezone, skip\\\\n        if !force {\\\\n            if let location = getLocation(for: deviceID),\\\\n               let placemark = getPlacemark(for: deviceID),\\\\n               (placemark.country != nil || placemark.locality != nil),\\\\n               location.timeZone != nil {\\\\n                return\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        guard let _ = getLocation(for: deviceID) else { return }\\\\n        // Avoid duplicates in queue\\\\n        if !geocodeQueue.contains(deviceID) {\\\\n            geocodeQueue.append(deviceID)\\\\n        }\\\\n        processNextGeocode()\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    func getTimeZone(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; TimeZone? {\\\\n        return getLocation(for: deviceID)?.timeZone\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    func forceGeocodingForAllDevices() {\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: location.deviceID, force: true)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func processNextGeocode() {\\\\n        guard !isProcessingGeocode else { return }\\\\n        guard !geocodeQueue.isEmpty else { return }\\\\n        isProcessingGeocode = true\\\\n        let nextDeviceID = geocodeQueue.removeFirst()\\\\n        guard let cached = getLocation(for: nextDeviceID) else {\\\\n            isProcessingGeocode = false\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in\\\\n                self?.processNextGeocode()\\\\n            }\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n        let location = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in\\\\n            guard let self = self else { return }\\\\n            let pm = placemarks?.first\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                if let pm = pm {\\\\n                    let country = pm.country\\\\n                    let locality = pm.locality ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\\\\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\\\\n                    self.setPlacemark(for: nextDeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\\\\n                }\\\\n                self.isProcessingGeocode = false\\\\n                // Be polite with geocoder\\\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {\\\\n                    self.processNextGeocode()\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n} \\\\n\\\",\""
