Please try again.\\\\\\\")\\\\n                )\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func openInAppleMaps() {\\\\n        // Open the route in the Apple Maps app using the selected transport type\\\\n        guard let dest = deviceCoordinate else { return }\\\\n        let source: MKMapItem\\\\n        let destination: MKMapItem\\\\n        if isRouteReversed {\\\\n            source = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\\\\n            source.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\\\\n            destination = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            source = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\\\\n            destination = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\\\\n            destination.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\\\\n        }\\\\n        var options: [String: Any] = [:]\\\\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\\\\n        case 0: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeWalking\\\\n        case 3: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeTransit\\\\n        default: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeDriving\\\\n        }\\\\n        MKMapItem.openMaps(with: [source, destination], launchOptions: options)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func transportTypeFromSetting(_ value: Int) -&amp;amp;gt; MKDirectionsTransportType {\\\\n        switch value {\\\\n        case 0: return .walking\\\\n        case 3: return .transit\\\\n        default: return .automobile\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\\\\n        debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error: \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // MARK: - Remote updates for the selected device only\\\\n\\\\n    private func fetchTargetDeviceLocation(resetAndRecenter: Bool, ignoreRouteCache: Bool = false) async {\\\\n        // Fetch latest location for just the selected device from the server.\\\\n        // Updates the shared device cache and view state. Recalculates route only\\\\n        // when explicitly re-centered (e.g., manual reload) or when auto-update logic decides so.\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else { return }\\\\n        do {\\\\n            isLoading = true\\\\n            defer { isLoading = false }\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    private func refreshCachedDeviceCoordinates() {\\\\n        var dict: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [:]\\\\n        if let mainCoord = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n    private func handleDeviceTap(deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) {\\\\n        let nearby = precomputedNearbyDevices[deviceID] ?? nearbyDevices(around: deviceID, coordinate: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\\\\n            if let cached = longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n        let currentItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, weak self] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let self else { return }\\\\n                guard let active = self.nearbyComputeWorkItem, active === currentItem else { return }\\\\n                self.precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = currentItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: currentItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n showErrorOverlay(\\\\\\\"Invalid server response\\\\\\\", NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_response_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server response was invalid.\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            case }\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            showErrorOverlay(error.localizedDescription, NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"error_loading_locationdata\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error loading location data\\\\\\\"))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; = deviceCoordinate(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            dict[deviceID] = mainCoord\\\\n        }\\\\n        for other in deviceStore.devices where other.DeviceID != deviceID {\\\\n            if let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: other.DeviceID) {\\\\n                dict[other.DeviceID] = coord\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Avoid redundant work if coordinates did not change\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\\\\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\\\\n                return (known, cached)\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n        // Prepare lookup once for the background computation\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n\\\\n        let workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, active === workItem else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Preloads history before navigating to the dedicated history map to avoid switching views when no data exists.\\\\n    private func preloadHistoryAndNavigate(for are available. Shows an overlay on the current map if empty or failed.\\\\n    private func fetchHistoryBeforeNavigation(for device: KnownDevice) async {\\\\n\\\\n        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\\\\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\\\\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\\\\n                await MainActor.run {\\\\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"history_no_data\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"No history available placeholder\\\\\\\"))\\\\n                }\\\\n            } else {\\\\n                await MainActor.run {\\\\n                    showHistoryView = true\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\\\\n            await MainActor.run {\\\\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\\\\\\\"))\\\\n            }\\\\n            return\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\\\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\\\\n                serverURL: url,\\\\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\\\\n                amount: 10000\\\\n            )\\\\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\\\\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &amp;amp;lt; $1.TimestampDate }\\\\n\\\\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\\\\n                await MainActor.run {\\\\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"history_no_data\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"No history available placeholder\\\\\\\"))\\\\n                }\\\\n                return\\\\n            }\\\\n\\\\n            await MainActor.run {\\\\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\\\\n                showHistoryView = true\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\\\\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)\\\\n            await MainActor.run {\\\\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: message)\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            await MainActor.run {\\\\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: error.localizedDescription)\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func mapHistoryAPIError(_ error: MiataruAPIClient.APIError) -&amp;amp;gt; String {\\\\n        switch error {\\\\n        case .invalidURL:\\\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_url_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server URL is invalid.\\\\\\\")\\\\n        case .invalidResponse(_):\\\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"server_response_invalid\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"The server response was invalid.\\\\\\\")\\\\n        case .encodingError(let err):\\\\n            return \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"encoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error encoding the request.\\\\\\\")) \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\"\\\\n        case .decodingError(let err):\\\\n            return \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"decoding_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Error processing the server response.\\\\\\\")) \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\"\\\\n        case .requestFailed(let err):\\\\n            return \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\(NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"network_error\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Network error. Please check your internet connection.\\\\\\\")) \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\"\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func normalizeHistoryEntries(from entries: [MiataruLocationData]) -&amp;amp;gt; [MiataruLocationData] {\\\\n        var uniqueEntries: [MiataruLocationData] = []\\\\n        uniqueEntries.reserveCapacity(entries.count)\\\\n\\\\n        var seenKeys = Set&amp;amp;lt;String&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n        var droppedDuplicates = 0\\\\n        var droppedInvalid = 0\\\\n\\\\n        for entry in entries {\\\\n            guard entry.Latitude.isFinite, entry.Longitude.isFinite else {\\\\n                droppedInvalid += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            }\\\\n\\\\n            let key = \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\(entry.Timestamp)|\\\\\\\\(entry.Latitude)|\\\\\\\\(entry.Longitude)\\\\\\\"\\\\n            if seenKeys.insert(key).inserted {\\\\n                uniqueEntries.append(entry)\\\\n            } else {\\\\n                droppedDuplicates += 1\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        if droppedDuplicates &amp;amp;gt; 0 || droppedInvalid &amp;amp;gt; 0 {\\\\n            debugLog(\\\\\\\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\\\\\\\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\\\\\\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\\\\\\\(droppedInvalid)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return uniqueEntries\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\\\\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\\\\n        guard interval &amp;amp;gt; 0 else { return }\\\\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\\\\n            }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\\\\n        timerCancellable = nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        startAutoUpdate()\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\\\\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\\\\n        debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error: \\\\\\\\(debugMessage)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Aligns the map to north (heading = 0)\\\\n    private func alignMapToNorth() {\\\\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\\\\n        guard let currentCamera = currentMapCamera else { return }\\\\n        let newCamera = MapCamera(\\\\n            centerCoordinate: coordinate,\\\\n            distance: currentCamera.distance,\\\\n            heading: 0, // North\\\\n            pitch: currentCamera.pitch\\\\n        )\\\\n        beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 0.5)\\\\n        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {\\\\n            cameraPosition = .camera(newCamera)\\\\n            userHasRotatedMap = false // Hide compass when aligned to north\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Resets the map zoom to the value from settings\\\\n    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\\\\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\\\\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\\\\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\\\\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\\\\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\\\\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 0.5)\\\\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {\\\\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\\\\n                currentMapSpan = span\\\\n            }\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 0.5)\\\\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {\\\\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Custom modifier to conditionally show navigation title based on iOS version\\\\nstruct NavigationTitleModifier: ViewModifier {\\\\n    let deviceName: String\\\\n    \\\\n    func body(content: Content) -&amp;amp;gt; some View {\\\\n        if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {\\\\n            content\\\\n        } else {\\\\n count = 0\\\\n        // Main device\\\\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\\\\n            count += 1\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\\\\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n        for other in others {\\\\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\\\\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\\\\n                    count += 1\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#Preview {\\\\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \\\\\\\"Test Device\\\\\\\", deviceID: \\\\\\\"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\\\\\\\", color: .red)\\\\n    let mockLocation = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.405) // Berlin\\\\n    let mockAccuracy = 15.0\\\\n    let mockTimestamp = Date()\\\\n    return NavigationView {\\\\n        iPhone_DeviceMapView(\\\\n            deviceID: mockDevice.DeviceID,\\\\n            previewDeviceLocation: mockLocation,\\\\n            previewDeviceAccuracy: mockAccuracy,\\\\n            previewDeviceTimestamp: mockTimestamp,\\\\n            onNavigateToDevice: { deviceID in\\\\n                debugLog(\\\\\\\"Preview: Would navigate to device \\\\\\\\(deviceID)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            }\\\\n        )\\\\n let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\\\\n            return (known, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n\\\\n        let workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Preloads history before navigating to the dedicated history map to avoid switching views when no data exists.\\\\n    private func preloadHistoryAndNavigate(for nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, isHistoryPreloading = true\\\\n        Task {\\\\n            await fetchHistoryBeforeNavigation(for: device)\\\\n            await MainActor.run {\\\\n                isHistoryPreloading = false\\\\n Please check your internet connection.\\\\\\\")) \\\\\\\\(err.localizedDescription)\\\\\\\"\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func normalizeHistoryEntries(from entries: entry.Latitude.isFinite, entry.Longitude.isFinite else {\\\\n                droppedInvalid += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            }\\\\n\\\\n            let key = debugLog(\\\\\\\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\\\\\\\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\\\\\\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\\\\\\\(droppedInvalid)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return uniqueEntries\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        // Only consider devices that already have cached coordinates (i.e., are eligible for map annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        guard let _ = cachedDeviceCoordinates[deviceID] else {\\\\n            return []\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\\\\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let ordered = ([id] + nearbyIDs.sorted { (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n        // Prepare lookup once for the background computation\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n entry.Latitude.isFinite, entry.Longitude.isFinite else {\\\\n                droppedInvalid += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            }\\\\n\\\\n            let key = debugLog(\\\\\\\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\\\\\\\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\\\\\\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\\\\\\\(droppedInvalid)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return uniqueEntries\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\\\\n            }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\\\\n        timerCancellable = nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [KnownDevice] {\\\\n        // Only consider devices that already have cached coordinates (i.e., are eligible for map annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        guard let _ = cachedDeviceCoordinates[deviceID] else {\\\\n            return []\\\\n        }\\\\n        \\\\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n cached.longitude)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n                let loc = CLLocation(latitude: otherCoord.latitude, longitude: otherCoord.longitude)\\\\n                if targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters {\\\\n                    nearbyIDs.append(otherID)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            guard !nearbyIDs.isEmpty else { continue }\\\\n            let }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n        // Prepare lookup once for the background as annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: as annotations)\\\\n        let deviceLookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = cachedDeviceCoordinates.compactMap { id, coord in\\\\n            guard let device = deviceLookup[id] else { return nil }\\\\n            return (device, coord)\\\\n coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\\\\n        \\\\n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n        }.map { $0.0 }\\\\n        \\\\n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\\\\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\\\\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\\\\n                return animated\\\\n            }\\\\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\\\\n                return current\\\\n            }\\\\n nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue }\\\\n (deviceLookup[$0]?.DeviceName ?? $0)\\\\n                .localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(deviceLookup[$1]?.DeviceName ?? $1) == .orderedAscending })\\\\n                .compactMap { deviceLookup[$0] }\\\\n            if ordered.count &amp;amp;gt; 1 {\\\\n                result[id] = ordered\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        return result\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func scheduleNearbyPrecompute(with coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) {\\\\n        let lookup = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: deviceStore.devices.map { ($0.DeviceID, $0) })\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem?.cancel()\\\\n\\\\n        var workItem: DispatchWorkItem?\\\\n        workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [threshold = 35.0, coords, lookup] in\\\\n            let groups = computeNearbyGroups(from: coords, deviceLookup: lookup, thresholdMeters: threshold)\\\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\\\n                guard let active = nearbyComputeWorkItem, let current = workItem, active === current else { return }\\\\n                precomputedNearbyDevices = groups\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        guard let workItem else { return }\\\\n        nearbyComputeWorkItem = workItem\\\\n        Self.nearbyComputeQueue.async(execute: workItem)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func coordinatesEqual(lhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], rhs: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D]) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard lhs.count == rhs.count else { return false }\\\\n        for (key, value) in lhs {\\\\n            guard let other = rhs[key] else { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.latitude - other.latitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return false }\\\\n            if abs(value.longitude - other.longitude) &amp;amp;gt; .ulpOfOne { return pair in\\\\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\\\\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &amp;amp;lt;= thresholdMeters\\\\n .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\\\\n        \\\\n        if let tapped {\\\\n            return [tapped] + others\\\\n        }\\\\n        return others\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\\\\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\\\\n            if let return nil\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], deviceLookup: [String: KnownDevice], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&amp;amp;gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\\\\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]\\\\n        \\\\n        for (id, coord) in coords {\\\\n            let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coord.latitude, longitude: coord.longitude)\\\\n            var nearbyIDs: [String] = []\\\\n            for (otherID, otherCoord) in coords {\\\\n                guard otherID != id else { continue entry.Latitude.isFinite, entry.Longitude.isFinite else {\\\\n                droppedInvalid += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            }\\\\n\\\\n            let key = debugLog(\\\\\\\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\\\\\\\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\\\\\\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\\\\\\\(droppedInvalid)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return uniqueEntries\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\\\\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing in: .common)\\\\n            .autoconnect()\\\\n            .sink { _ in\\\\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\\\\n            }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\\\\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\\\\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\\\\n        timerCancellable = nil\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\\\\n Both widgets will support multiple sizes and use App Groups for shared data access.\\\\\\\"\\\\ntodos:\\\\n  - id: shared-data\\\\n    content: Create SharedWidgetData.swift with Codable models and App Group file manager\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: app-group-sync\\\\n    content: Update DeviceLocationCacheStore and KnownDeviceStore to sync to App Group\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: map-snapshot\\\\n    content: Create WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator for pre-rendering map images with markers\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-extension\\\\n    content: Create miataruWidgets extension target with bundle entry point\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: text-widget\\\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationTextWidget with small, medium, and lock screen sizes\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: map-widget\\\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationMapWidget with small, medium, and large sizes\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-intent\\\\n    content: Create device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-reload\\\\n    content: Add WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines() calls on data updates\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\\\n\\\\n## Architecture Overview\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;mermaid\\\\nflowchart TB\\\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    LM --&amp;amp;gt; DLC\\\\n    DLC --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    KDS --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    mainApp --&amp;amp;gt; MI\\\\n    SD --&amp;amp;gt; TP\\\\n    MI --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; TW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Key Implementation Details\\\\n\\\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\\\n\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\n\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\n\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;**Files to create**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\\\\n\\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\\\n\\\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\\\n\\\\n- Call &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;amp;#96; on location updates\\\\n- Trigger &amp;amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;amp;#96; after sync\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](KnownDeviceStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\\\n\\\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\\\n\\\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\\\n\\\\n- Create &amp;amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;amp;#96; in main app\\\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; \\\\n- Draw &amp;amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;amp;#96; onto snapshot\\\\n- Save to App Group container\\\\n\\\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\\\n\\\\n- Widget reads \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location from shared data\\\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\\\n\\\\n### 8. Deep Link Handling\\\\n\\\\n- Use &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; / &amp;amp;#96;Link&amp;amp;#96; to set &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; for all widgets\\\\n- Ensure main app openURL routing brings the user directly to the selected device detail/map\\\\n\\\\n## Widget Configuration\\\\n\\\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\\\n\\\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;amp;#96; devices\\\\n- Excludes \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\\\n\\\\n## File Structure\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;javascript\\\\nmiataru/\\\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\\\n├── views/\\\\n│   └── Common/\\\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\\\n├── Info.plist\\\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\\\n\\\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\\",\""

App Group Setup\\\\n\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\n\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\n\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;**Files to create**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\\\\n\\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. []\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\\\n\\\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n#if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\\\\\(requestIDs): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n#endif\\\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n\\\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\\\n\\\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n                id: location.Device,\\\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var set = Set&amp;amp;lt;String&amp;amp;gt;()\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty { set.insert(primary) }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty { set.insert(additional) }\\\\n        return Array(set)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\\\\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\\\\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\\\\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\\\\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\\\\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\\\\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\\\n\\\\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\\\\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        syncWidgetConfig(\\\\n            serverURL: SettingsManager.shared.miataruServerURL,\\\\n            deviceIDs: devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\\\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\\\n            shouldReloadTimelines: false\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\\\n        #endif\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Sync only the widget configuration (server + device IDs) into the shared container.\\\\n    static func syncWidgetConfig(serverURL: String, deviceIDs: [String], ownDeviceID: String, shouldReloadTimelines: Bool = true) {\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfig(\\\\n            miataruServerURL: serverURL,\\\\n            deviceIDs: deviceIDs,\\\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\\\n            authorizationToken: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n        SharedWidgetConfigManager.write(config)\\\\n\\\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\n        if shouldReloadTimelines {\\\\n            WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\\\n        }\\\\n        #endif\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\\\\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"plan\\\": \\\"# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\\\n\\\\n## Architecture Overview\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;mermaid\\\\nflowchart TB\\\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    LM --&amp;amp;gt; DLC\\\\n    DLC --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    KDS --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    mainApp --&amp;amp;gt; MI\\\\n    SD --&amp;amp;gt; TP\\\\n    MI --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; TW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Key Implementation Details\\\\n\\\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\\\n\\\\n**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Files to create**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Approach**: \\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\\\n- Call &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;amp;#96; on location updates\\\\n- Trigger &amp;amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;amp;#96; after sync\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\\\n\\\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\\\n- Create &amp;amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;amp;#96; in main app\\\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; \\\\n- Draw &amp;amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;amp;#96; onto snapshot\\\\n- Save to App Group container\\\\n\\\\n### 7.                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"    \\\"content\\\": \\\"/*\\\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\\\n *\\\\n * WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift\\\\n * miataru\\\\n *\\\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\\\n */\\\\n\\\\nimport Foundation\\\\nimport CoreLocation\\\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\\\nimport UIKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n#if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\nimport WidgetKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n\\\\n/// Bridges the main app data (devices + cached locations) into the App Group JSON\\\\n/// that widgets consume. All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\\\\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\\\\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\\\\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\\\\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\\\\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\\\\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\\\n\\\\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\\\\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n\\\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\\\n        #endif\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\\\\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\\\\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\\\\n\\\\n        for device in devices {\\\\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\\\\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\\\\n            entries.append(entry)\\\\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\\\\n                ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: entries,\\\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// MARK: - Helpers\\\\n\\\\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\\\\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\\\\n        WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n            id: device.DeviceID,\\\\n            name: device.DeviceName,\\\\n            latitude: location.latitude,\\\\n            longitude: location.longitude,\\\\n            locality: location.locality,\\\\n            country: location.country,\\\\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\\\\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\\\\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\\\\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetColor? {\\\\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\\\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;amp;a)\\\\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\",\""

{\\\\n+         guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\\\n+         var r: CGFloat = 0\\\\n+         var g: CGFloat = 0\\\\n+         var b: CGFloat = 0\\\\n+         var a: CGFloat = 0\\\\n+         uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;amp;a)\\\\n+         return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\\\n+     }\\\\n+ }\\\\n+ \\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contentsAfterEdit\\\": \\\"/*\\\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\\\n *\\\\n * WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift\\\\n * miataru\\\\n *\\\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\\\n */\\\\n\\\\nimport Foundation\\\\nimport CoreLocation\\\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\\\nimport UIKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n#if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\nimport WidgetKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n\\\\n/// Bridges the main app data (devices + cached locations) into the App Group JSON\\\\n/// that widgets consume. All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\\\\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\\\\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\\\\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\\\\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\\\\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\\\\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\\\n\\\\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\\\\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n\\\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\\\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\\\n        #endif\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\\\\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\\\\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\\\\n\\\\n        for device in devices {\\\\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\\\\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\\\\n            entries.append(entry)\\\\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\\\\n                ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: entries,\\\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// MARK: - Helpers\\\\n\\\\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\\\\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\\\\n        WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n            id: device.DeviceID,\\\\n            name: device.DeviceName,\\\\n            latitude: location.latitude,\\\\n            longitude: location.longitude,\\\\n            locality: location.locality,\\\\n            country: location.country,\\\\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\\\\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\\\\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\\\\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetColor? {\\\\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\\\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\\\\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;amp;a)\\\\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"- Push-style reloads (main app changes): Whenever the app refreshes device locations (e.g., a poll from the server or your own location update), it writes the shared payload and calls &amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;#96;. That gives you a near-immediate widget refresh, subject to system throttling.\""

                {
                  "lineNumber": 10214,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"- The app, when it refreshes device locations (e.g., from the server or your own location update), writes the shared payload and calls &amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;#96;. That’s what pushes updated locations into the widgets, subject to OS throttling.\""

                  "lineNumber": 10230,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"- Fetch on timeline build: In &amp;#96;timeline(for:)&amp;#96; for both text and map widgets, load shared settings, call &amp;#96;MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(...)&amp;#96; for the selected device, then update the App Group cache (&amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.write&amp;#96;) and return the entry. Keep the 15-minute policy, but use the fresh fetch result when available.\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"    \\\"content\\\": \\\"/*\\\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\\\n *\\\\n * WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift\\\\n * miataru\\\\n *\\\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\\\n */\\\\n\\\\nimport Foundation\\\\nimport MiataruAPIClient\\\\n\\\\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\\\\nenum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {\\\\n    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, generateMapSnapshots: Bool = false) async -&amp;amp;gt; (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {\\\\n        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\\\\n        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\\\n\\\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n#if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\\\\\(requestIDs): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n#endif\\\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n\\\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\\\n\\\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n                id: location.Device,\\\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

Shared Data Layer\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\\\n\\\\n**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5.
