                  "lineNumber": 428,
                  "content": "    \"content\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MiataruAPIClient\\n\\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\\nenum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {\\n    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, generateMapSnapshots: Bool = false) async -&amp;gt; (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {\\n        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\\n        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\n\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\n            devices: [],\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\n            ownDevice: nil\\n        )\\n\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n            return (payload, device)\\n        }\\n\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n            return (payload, device)\\n        }\\n\\n        do {\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\n            )\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\n        } catch {\\n#if DEBUG\\n            print(\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\(requestIDs): \\\\(error)\\\")\\n#endif\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\n        }\\n\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\n        }\\n\\n        return (payload, device)\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;gt; [String] {\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\n        }\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\n        }\\n        return ordered\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\n\\n        for location in locations {\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\n\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\n                id: location.Device,\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\n                color: metadata?.color\\n            )\\n\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\n\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        return updatedPayload\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\","

                  "content": "    \"content\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport CoreLocation\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\nimport UIKit\\n#endif\\n#if canImport(WidgetKit)\\nimport WidgetKit\\n#endif\\n\\n/// Bridges the main app data (devices + cached locations) into the App Group JSON\\n/// that widgets consume. All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\n\\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\n        syncWidgetConfig(\\n            serverURL: SettingsManager.shared.miataruServerURL,\\n            deviceIDs: devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\n            shouldReloadTimelines: false\\n        )\\n\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\n        #endif\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Sync only the widget configuration (server + device IDs) into the shared container.\\n    static func syncWidgetConfig(serverURL: String, deviceIDs: [String], ownDeviceID: String, shouldReloadTimelines: Bool = true) {\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfig(\\n            miataruServerURL: serverURL,\\n            deviceIDs: deviceIDs,\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\n            authorizationToken: nil\\n        )\\n        SharedWidgetConfigManager.write(config)\\n\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\n        if shouldReloadTimelines {\\n            WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\n        }\\n        #endif\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\\n\\n        for device in devices {\\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\\n            entries.append(entry)\\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\\n                ownDevice = entry\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\\n            devices: entries,\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\\n        )\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// MARK: - Helpers\\n\\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\\n        WidgetDeviceData(\\n            id: device.DeviceID,\\n            name: device.DeviceName,\\n            latitude: location.latitude,\\n            longitude: location.longitude,\\n            locality: location.locality,\\n            country: location.country,\\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\\n        )\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&amp;gt; WidgetColor? {\\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;a)\\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\","

WidgetColor? {\\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;a)\\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\""

                  "content": "    \"content\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MiataruAPIClient\\n\\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\\nenum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {\\n    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -&amp;gt; (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {\\n        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\\n        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\n\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\n            devices: [],\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\n            ownDevice: nil\\n        )\\n\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n            return (payload, device)\\n        }\\n\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n            return (payload, device)\\n        }\\n\\n        do {\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\n            )\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\n        } catch {\\n#if DEBUG\\n            print(\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\(requestIDs): \\\\(error)\\\")\\n#endif\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\n        }\\n\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\n        return (payload, device)\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;gt; [String] {\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\n        }\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\n        }\\n        return ordered\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\n\\n        for location in locations {\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\n\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\n                id: location.Device,\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\n                color: metadata?.color\\n            )\\n\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\n\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        return updatedPayload\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\","

location.Device,\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\n                color: metadata?.color\\n            )\\n\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\n\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        return updatedPayload\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\""

App Group Setup\\n- Create App Group: &amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;#96;\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\n\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\n\\n**File**: &amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\n- &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\n- Include \\\"this device\\\" location for distance calculations\\n\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\nCreate new target: &amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;#96;\\n\\n**Files to create**:\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\n\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\nShows: \\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\"\\n\\n**Supported sizes**:\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\n- &amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\n\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay\\n\\n**Approach**: \\n- Main app generates &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; images when location updates\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\n\\n**Supported sizes**:\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\n- &amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\n\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:\\n\\n**Update** [&amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\n- Call &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;#96; on location updates\\n- Trigger &amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;#96; after sync\\n\\n**Update** [&amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\n\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\n- Create &amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;#96; in main app\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; \\n- Draw &amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;#96; onto snapshot\\n- Save to App Group container\\n\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\n- Widget reads \\\"this device\\\" location from shared data\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;#96;\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\n\\n## Widget Configuration\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;#96; devices\\n- Excludes \\\"this device\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\n\\n## File Structure\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nmiataru/\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\n├── views/\\n│   └── Common/\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\n├── Info.plist\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\n- Add WidgetKit framework dependency\\n\","

                  "content": "    \"content\": \"---\\nname: Miataru iOS Widgets\\noverview: \\\"Add a WidgetKit extension with two widget types: a text-based location widget showing device location and distance, and a map snapshot widget showing a rendered map image. Both widgets will support multiple sizes and use App Groups for shared data access.\\\"\\ntodos:\\n  - id: shared-data\\n    content: Create SharedWidgetData.swift with Codable models and App Group file manager\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: app-group-sync\\n    content: Update DeviceLocationCacheStore and KnownDeviceStore to sync to App Group\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: map-snapshot\\n    content: Create WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator for pre-rendering map images with markers\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-extension\\n    content: Create miataruWidgets extension target with bundle entry point\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: text-widget\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationTextWidget with small, medium, and lock screen sizes\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: map-widget\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationMapWidget with small, medium, and large sizes\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-intent\\n    content: Create device selection intent for widget configuration\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-reload\\n    content: Add WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines() calls on data updates\\n    status: pending\\n---\\n\\n# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\n\\n## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TB\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\n    end\\n    \\n    LM --&amp;gt; DLC\\n    DLC --&amp;gt; SD\\n    KDS --&amp;gt; SD\\n    mainApp --&amp;gt; MI\\n    SD --&amp;gt; TP\\n    MI --&amp;gt; MW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; TW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; MW\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n\\n\\n## Key Implementation Details\\n\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\n\\n- Create App Group: &amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;#96;\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\n\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\n\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;#96;\\n\\n- &amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\n- &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\n- Include \\\"this device\\\" location for distance calculations\\n\\n### 3. All calls are lightweight and overwrite the shared file.\\nenum WidgetDataSyncCoordinator {\\n    /// Syncs all known devices and cached locations into the shared payload and refreshes widgets.\\n    static func syncAllDevices() {\\n        let devices = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices\\n        let locations = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.locations\\n        let ownDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\\n\\n        let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)\\n        SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\n\\n        #if canImport(WidgetKit)\\n        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()\\n        #endif\\n    }\\n\\n    /// Builds the payload from the current stores.\\n    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\\n\\n        for device in devices {\\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\\n            entries.append(entry)\\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\\n                ownDevice = entry\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\\n            devices: entries,\\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\\n        )\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// MARK: - Helpers\\n\\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\\n        WidgetDeviceData(\\n            id: device.DeviceID,\\n            name: device.DeviceName,\\n            latitude: location.latitude,\\n            longitude: location.longitude,\\n            locality: location.locality,\\n            country: location.country,\\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\\n        )\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&amp;gt; WidgetColor? {\\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;amp;r, green: &amp;amp;g, blue: &amp;amp;b, alpha: &amp;amp;a)\\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\\n    }\\n}\\n\","

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Analyzing widget behavior**

I'm noticing there's no auth header support in the API client, so the widget should fetch data without authentication. If the server had changed, the app would also fail, but it seems to work when open, possibly due to cached data. I'm realizing that perhaps the server doesn't require auth, but I need to figure out why the widget is frozen until the app opens. It could be issues with WidgetKit, timeline policies, or throttling if entries are identical.
**Investigating widget updates**

The user mentioned that the widget only updates when the app is open, suggesting the timeline isn't being requested in the background, which seems unusual. The map widget uses an `AppIntentTimelineProvider` and might need an `AppIntents` extension for iOS 17. It could be that the heavy map snapshot generation in `generateMapSnapshots` is causing delays. If the device timestamp comes from the server and is newer than the local time, that could lead to continuous regeneration of snapshots, which might be expensive but doesn't prevent refreshes.
**Investigating widget configuration**

I’m considering whether the widget isn’t fetching data because `config` is nil due to issues with the app group identifier in `SharedWidgetConfigManager`. That might affect the `SharedWidgetDataManager` as well. The problem could stem from `WidgetDataSyncCoordinator`, which writes an authorization token as nil. The config should exist if the app has run at least once, but if it hasn't run recently, the cached data might be stale. If the server URL is invalid or missing an HTTPS scheme, that could block fetching updates.
**Exploring widget fetching issues**

It looks like the widget needs a proper URL format since `URL(string:)` can return nil if the scheme is missing. This could explain why the widget only updates when the app is open, as the app writes a shared payload after fetching new data. I’ll need to check the `SettingsManager.miataruServerURL` to ensure it includes "https." While examining that, I should also look at the `MiataruAPIClient.getLocation` call to confirm the server URL is the base without a trailing path. The widget's refresh rate is set to 15 minutes, which could contribute to it appearing frozen.
**Understanding widget refresh behavior**

I've realized that the widget view only recomputes when it refreshes, so the "updated ... ago" message won’t change until the next scheduled refresh. If the timeline isn’t reloading, it could indicate that the system isn't allowing background network requests due to limitations with `URLSession.shared`. Although widgets can handle small network tasks, long or failed requests might cause the system to reduce the refresh rate. It’s possible the app triggers the reload, updating data quickly, which could explain why the widget updates only when the app is open. I'll inspect the `DeviceLocationTextWidget` and `WidgetIntents` for similar issues.</details></think>

              "matches": [
                {
                  "lineNumber": 74,
                  "content": "Nice, the widget view always loads a PNG from the app-group container named like &#96;MapSnapshot-&lt;deviceID&gt;-dark.png&#96; / &#96;...-light.png&#96;. So if the timeline is updating but the map isn’t, the likely culprit is **snapshot generation/caching**: either the snapshot file isn’t being regenerated every fetch, or it’s overwritten in a way WidgetKit isn’t picking up. Next I’ll find where those &#96;MapSnapshot-...png&#96; files are created and make sure they’re refreshed and versioned correctly."

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 586,
                  "content": "The **map widget timeline was fetching fresh location data**, so the overlay text (“updated … ago”) refreshed, but the widget **was only displaying a pre-rendered PNG** (&#96;MapSnapshot-&lt;deviceID&gt;-light/dark.png&#96;) that previously got generated by the main app. If the app didn’t run (or didn’t regenerate snapshots), the **image stayed stale** even while the timeline data was new."

Both widgets will support multiple sizes and use App Groups for shared data access.\\\\\\\"\\\\ntodos:\\\\n  - id: shared-data\\\\n    content: Create SharedWidgetData.swift with Codable models and App Group file manager\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: app-group-sync\\\\n    content: Update DeviceLocationCacheStore and KnownDeviceStore to sync to App Group\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: map-snapshot\\\\n    content: Create WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator for pre-rendering map images with markers\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-extension\\\\n    content: Create miataruWidgets extension target with bundle entry point\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: text-widget\\\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationTextWidget with small, medium, and lock screen sizes\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: map-widget\\\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationMapWidget with small, medium, and large sizes\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-intent\\\\n    content: Create device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n  - id: widget-reload\\\\n    content: Add WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines() calls on data updates\\\\n    status: pending\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\\\n\\\\n## Architecture Overview\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;mermaid\\\\nflowchart TB\\\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    LM --&amp;amp;gt; DLC\\\\n    DLC --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    KDS --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    mainApp --&amp;amp;gt; MI\\\\n    SD --&amp;amp;gt; TP\\\\n    MI --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; TW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Key Implementation Details\\\\n\\\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\\\n\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\n\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\n\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;**Files to create**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\\\\n\\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\\\n\\\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\\\n\\\\n- Call &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;amp;#96; on location updates\\\\n- Trigger &amp;amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;amp;#96; after sync\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](KnownDeviceStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\\\n\\\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\\\n\\\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\\\n\\\\n- Create &amp;amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;amp;#96; in main app\\\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; \\\\n- Draw &amp;amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;amp;#96; onto snapshot\\\\n- Save to App Group container\\\\n\\\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\\\n\\\\n- Widget reads \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location from shared data\\\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\\\n\\\\n### 8. Deep Link Handling\\\\n\\\\n- Use &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; / &amp;amp;#96;Link&amp;amp;#96; to set &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; for all widgets\\\\n- Ensure main app openURL routing brings the user directly to the selected device detail/map\\\\n\\\\n## Widget Configuration\\\\n\\\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\\\n\\\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;amp;#96; devices\\\\n- Excludes \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\\\n\\\\n## File Structure\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;javascript\\\\nmiataru/\\\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\\\n├── views/\\\\n│   └── Common/\\\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\\\n├── Info.plist\\\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\\\n\\\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\\",\""

Shared Data Layer\\\\n\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\n\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;**Files to create**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\n\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\\\\n\\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Tap action**: &amp;amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;amp;#96; deep link to &amp;amp;#96;miataru://&amp;amp;lt;deviceID&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\\\n\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. UIKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n\\\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a simple device marker) and writes them into\\\\n/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\\\n///\\\\n/// Why this exists in the widget extension:\\\\n/// The widget timeline can fetch fresh location data, but without regenerating the snapshot\\\\n/// image the map can remain stale while text updates (e.g. \\\\\\\"updated … ago\\\\\\\").\\\\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\\\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\\\n    #if canImport(UIKit)\\\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\\\n                                        size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 600, height: 600)) async {\\\\n        let ts = device.timestamp\\\\n        let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\\\\n\\\\n        // If either style is missing or older than the device timestamp, regenerate it.\\\\n        let needsLight = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .light, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\\\n        let needsDark = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .dark, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\\\n        guard needsLight || needsDark else { return }\\\\n\\\\n        if needsLight {\\\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .light)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if needsDark {\\\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .dark)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func needsRegeneration(deviceID: String, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle, deviceTimestamp: Date) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: deviceID, style: style) else { return true }\\\\n        guard let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),\\\\n              let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else {\\\\n            return true\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Regenerate if the snapshot predates the data we’re about to show.\\\\n        return modDate &amp;amp;lt; deviceTimestamp\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @MainActor\\\\n    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\\\n                                       coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\\\n                                       size: CGSize,\\\\n                                       style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {\\\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id, style: style) else { return }\\\\n\\\\n        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\\\n        options.size = size\\\\n        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\\\n        options.mapType = .standard\\\\n        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\\\n        options.showsBuildings = false\\\\n        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: device.accuracy)\\\\n        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\\\n            let marker = markerImage(for: device, style: style)\\\\n            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, markerImage: marker)\\\\n            if let data = image.pngData() {\\\\n                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            #if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to generate map snapshot (\\\\\\\\(style == .dark ? \\\\\\\"dark\\\\\\\" : \\\\\\\"light\\\\\\\")) for \\\\\\\\(device.id): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            #endif\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\\\n            center: coordinate,\\\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot,\\\\n                               coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\\\n                               size: CGSize,\\\\n                               markerImage: UIImage) -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\\\n\\\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\\\n            )\\\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: WidgetDeviceData, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        let color = uiColor(from: device.color) ?? UIColor.systemBlue\\\\n        let symbol = UIImage(systemName: \\\\\\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\\\\\") ?? UIImage()\\\\n        let tinted = symbol.withTintColor(color, renderingMode: .alwaysOriginal)\\\\n\\\\n        let target = CGSize(width: 44, height: 44)\\\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: target)\\\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\\\n            let rect = CGRect(origin: .zero, size: target)\\\\n            tinted.draw(in: rect.insetBy(dx: 2, dy: 2))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uiColor(from color: WidgetColor?) -&amp;amp;gt; UIColor? {\\\\n        guard let color else { return nil }\\\\n        return UIColor(red: color.red, green: color.green, blue: color.blue, alpha: color.alpha)\\\\n    }\\\\n    #else\\\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData, size: CGSize = .zero) async { }\\\\n    #endif\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contentsAfterEdit\\\": \\\"/*\\\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\\\n *\\\\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\\\\n * miataru\\\\n *\\\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-08.\\\\n */\\\\n\\\\nimport Foundation\\\\nimport MapKit\\\\n\\\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\\\nimport UIKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n\\\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a simple device marker) and writes them into\\\\n/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\\\n///\\\\n/// Why this exists in the widget extension:\\\\n/// The widget timeline can fetch fresh location data, but without regenerating the snapshot\\\\n/// image the map can remain stale while text updates (e.g. \\\\\\\"updated … ago\\\\\\\").\\\\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\\\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\\\n    #if canImport(UIKit)\\\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\\\n                                        size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 600, height: 600)) async {\\\\n        let ts = device.timestamp\\\\n        let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\\\\n\\\\n        // If either style is missing or older than the device timestamp, regenerate it.\\\\n        let needsLight = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .light, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\\\n        let needsDark = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .dark, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\\\n        guard needsLight || needsDark else { return }\\\\n\\\\n        if needsLight {\\\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .light)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if needsDark {\\\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .dark)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func needsRegeneration(deviceID: String, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle, deviceTimestamp: Date) -&amp;amp;gt; Bool {\\\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: deviceID, style: style) else { return true }\\\\n        guard let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),\\\\n              let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else {\\\\n            return true\\\\n        }\\\\n        // Regenerate if the snapshot predates the data we’re about to show.\\\\n        return modDate &amp;amp;lt; deviceTimestamp\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    @MainActor\\\\n    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\\\n                                       coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\\\n                                       size: CGSize,\\\\n                                       style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {\\\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id, style: style) else { return }\\\\n\\\\n        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\\\n        options.size = size\\\\n        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\\\n        options.mapType = .standard\\\\n        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\\\n        options.showsBuildings = false\\\\n        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: device.accuracy)\\\\n        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\\\n            let marker = markerImage(for: device, style: style)\\\\n            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, markerImage: marker)\\\\n            if let data = image.pngData() {\\\\n                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            #if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to generate map snapshot (\\\\\\\\(style == .dark ? \\\\\\\"dark\\\\\\\" : \\\\\\\"light\\\\\\\")) for \\\\\\\\(device.id): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            #endif\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\\\n            center: coordinate,\\\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot,\\\\n                               coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\\\n                               size: CGSize,\\\\n                               markerImage: UIImage) -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\\\n\\\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\\\n            )\\\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: WidgetDeviceData, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        let color = uiColor(from: device.color) ?? UIColor.systemBlue\\\\n        let symbol = UIImage(systemName: \\\\\\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\\\\\") ?? UIImage()\\\\n        let tinted = symbol.withTintColor(color, renderingMode: .alwaysOriginal)\\\\n\\\\n        let target = CGSize(width: 44, height: 44)\\\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: target)\\\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\\\n            let rect = CGRect(origin: .zero, size: target)\\\\n            tinted.draw(in: rect.insetBy(dx: 2, dy: 2))\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uiColor(from color: WidgetColor?) -&amp;amp;gt; UIColor? {\\\\n        guard let color else { return nil }\\\\n        return UIColor(red: color.red, green: color.green, blue: color.blue, alpha: color.alpha)\\\\n    }\\\\n    #else\\\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData, size: CGSize = .zero) async { }\\\\n    #endif\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\""

[]\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\\\n\\\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n#if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\\\\\(requestIDs): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n#endif\\\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n\\\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\\\n\\\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n                id: location.Device,\\\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

App Group Setup\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\\\n\\\\n**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Files to create**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Approach**: \\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\\\n- Call &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;amp;#96; on location updates\\\\n- Trigger &amp;amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;amp;#96; after sync\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\\\n\\\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\\\n- Create &amp;amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;amp;#96; in main app\\\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; \\\\n- Draw &amp;amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;amp;#96; onto snapshot\\\\n- Save to App Group container\\\\n\\\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\\\n- Widget reads \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location from shared data\\\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\\\n\\\\n## Widget Configuration\\\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;amp;#96; devices\\\\n- Excludes \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\\\n\\\\n## File Structure\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\nmiataru/\\\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\\\n├── views/\\\\n│   └── Common/\\\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\\\n├── Info.plist\\\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\\\n- Add WidgetKit framework dependency\\\\n\\\",\""

String ?? \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n        self.latitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \\\\\\\"latitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        self.longitude = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \\\\\\\"longitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        self.accuracy = aDecoder.decodeDouble(forKey: \\\\\\\"accuracy\\\\\\\")\\\\n        self.timestamp = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"timestamp\\\\\\\") as? Date ?? Date()\\\\n        self.country = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"country\\\\\\\") as? String\\\\n        self.locality = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"locality\\\\\\\") as? String\\\\n        if let timeZoneIdentifier = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"timeZoneIdentifier\\\\\\\") as? String {\\\\n            self.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: timeZoneIdentifier)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            self.timeZone = nil\\\\n        }\\\\n        self.batteryLevel = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"batteryLevel\\\\\\\") as? Double\\\\n        self.altitude = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"altitude\\\\\\\") as? Double\\\\n        self.speed = aDecoder.decodeObject(forKey: \\\\\\\"speed\\\\\\\") as? Double\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    func encode(with aCoder: NSCoder) {\\\\n        aCoder.encode(deviceID, forKey: \\\\\\\"deviceID\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(latitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"latitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(longitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"longitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(accuracy, forKey: \\\\\\\"accuracy\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(timestamp, forKey: \\\\\\\"timestamp\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(country, forKey: \\\\\\\"country\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(locality, forKey: \\\\\\\"locality\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(timeZone?.identifier, forKey: \\\\\\\"timeZoneIdentifier\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(batteryLevel, forKey: \\\\\\\"batteryLevel\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(altitude, forKey: \\\\\\\"altitude\\\\\\\")\\\\n        aCoder.encode(speed, forKey: \\\\\\\"speed\\\\\\\")\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    static var supportsSecureCoding: Bool {\\\\n        return true\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nclass DeviceLocationCacheStore: ObservableObject {\\\\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationCacheStore()\\\\n    \\\\n    @Published var locations: [CachedDeviceLocation] = [] {\\\\n        didSet {\\\\n            save()\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    private let fileName = \\\\\\\"deviceLocations.plist\\\\\\\"\\\\n    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()\\\\n    private var geocodeQueue: [String] = []\\\\n    private var isProcessingGeocode: Bool = false\\\\n    private var geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters: CLLocationDistance {\\\\n        CLLocationDistance(SettingsManager.shared.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private var fileURL: URL {\\\\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private init() {\\\\n        self.locations = load()\\\\n        // Enqueue reverse geocoding for any cached entries missing placemarks or timezone\\\\n        for loc in locations where (loc.country == nil &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; loc.locality == nil) || loc.timeZone == nil {\\\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: loc.deviceID)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    private func save() {\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: locations, requiringSecureCoding: true)\\\\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error saving device locations: \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private func load() -&amp;amp;gt; [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\\\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\\\\n        do {\\\\n            if let locations = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, CachedDeviceLocation.self, NSDate.self, NSString.self], from: data) as? [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\\\n                return locations\\\\n            }\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n            debugLog(\\\\\\\"Error loading device locations: \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            // Remove incompatible cache file to prevent repeated load failures\\\\n            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return []\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func setLocation(for deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\\\\n        var snapshotLocation: CachedDeviceLocation?\\\\n\\\\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\\\\n            let existing = locations[idx]\\\\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\\\\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\\\\n                deviceID: deviceID,\\\\n                latitude: latitude,\\\\n                longitude: longitude,\\\\n                accuracy: accuracy,\\\\n                timestamp: timestamp,\\\\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\\\\n                country: existing.country,\\\\n                locality: existing.locality,\\\\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\\\\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\\\\n                altitude: altitude,\\\\n                speed: speed ?? existing.speed\\\\n            )\\\\n            locations[idx] = updated\\\\n            snapshotLocation = updated\\\\n            if moved {\\\\n                // Re-geocode only on significant movement or if no placemark exists yet\\\\n                let hasPlacemark = (existing.country != nil) || (existing.locality != nil)\\\\n                let oldLoc = CLLocation(latitude: existing.latitude, longitude: existing.longitude)\\\\n                let newLoc = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)\\\\n                let distance = oldLoc.distance(from: newLoc)\\\\n                if !hasPlacemark || distance &amp;amp;gt;= geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters {\\\\n                    enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID, force: true)\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            let newLocation = CachedDeviceLocation(deviceID: deviceID, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: accuracy, timestamp: timestamp, batteryLevel: batteryLevel, altitude: altitude, speed: speed)\\\\n            locations.append(newLocation)\\\\n            snapshotLocation = newLocation\\\\n            // New entry: if no placemark present, enqueue\\\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID)\\\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        if let location = snapshotLocation,\\\\n           let device = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\\\\n            WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.generateSnapshot(for: device, location: location)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    func getLocation(for deviceID: String) -&amp;amp;gt; CachedDeviceLocation? canImport(UIKit)\\\\nimport UIKit\\\\n#endif\\\\n\\\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker and location text)\\\\n/// and writes them into the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\\\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\\\\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\\\\n            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID) else { return }\\\\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\\\\n\\\\n            let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\\\n            options.size = size\\\\n            let scale = await MainActor.run { UIScreen.main.scale }\\\\n            options.scale = scale\\\\n            options.mapType = .standard\\\\n            options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\\\n            options.showsBuildings = false\\\\n            options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)\\\\n\\\\n            do {\\\\n                let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\\\n                let markerImage = await markerImage(for: device)\\\\n                let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size, markerImage: markerImage)\\\\n                if let data = image.pngData() {\\\\n                    try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\\\n                }\\\\n            } catch {\\\\n                debugLog(\\\\\\\"Failed to generate widget map snapshot: \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\\\n            center: coordinate,\\\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\\\n        )\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\\\n\\\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\\\n        return renderer.image { context in\\\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\\\n\\\\n            // Draw marker\\\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\\\n            )\\\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\\\n\\\\n            // Location text overlay (locality / country + last update)\\\\n            let overlayText = overlayString(for: location)\\\\n            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()\\\\n            paragraph.alignment = .left\\\\n            let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [\\\\n                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13, weight: .semibold),\\\\n                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white,\\\\n                .paragraphStyle: paragraph,\\\\n                .shadow: textShadow()\\\\n            ]\\\\n            let textRect = CGRect(\\\\n                x: 8,\\\\n                y: size.height - 40,\\\\n                width: size.width - 16,\\\\n                height: 32\\\\n            )\\\\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;amp;gt; String {\\\\n        var components: [String] = []\\\\n        if let locality = location.locality { components.append(locality) }\\\\n        if let country = location.country { components.append(country) }\\\\n        let place = components.joined(separator: \\\\\\\", \\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\\\\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\\\\n        let relative = formatter.localizedString(for: location.timestamp, relativeTo: Date())\\\\n\\\\n        if place.isEmpty {\\\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\\\\\"widget_overlay_last_seen\\\\\\\", comment: \\\\\\\"Fallback overlay text when no placemark is available\\\\\\\").replacingOccurrences(of: \\\\\\\"%@\\\\\\\", with: relative)\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            return \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\(place) • \\\\\\\\(relative)\\\\\\\"\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func textShadow() -&amp;amp;gt; NSShadow {\\\\n        let shadow = NSShadow()\\\\n        shadow.shadowColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.6)\\\\n        shadow.shadowOffset = CGSize(width: 0, height: 1)\\\\n        shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 2\\\\n        return shadow\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -&amp;amp;gt; UIImage {\\\\n        await MainActor.run {\\\\n            let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\\\\n                color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\\\\n                height: 44,\\\\n                cacheEnabled: false,\\\\n                renderPadding: 10\\\\n            )\\\\n            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\\\\n            renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\\\n            renderer.isOpaque = false\\\\n            return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: \\\\\\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\\\\\") ?? UIImage()\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

[]\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\\\n\\\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n#if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\\\\\(requestIDs): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n#endif\\\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n\\\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\\\n\\\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n                id: location.Device,\\\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""
