[]\\\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\\\n\\\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\\\\n            devices: [],\\\\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\\\\n            ownDevice: nil\\\\n        )\\\\n\\\\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\\\\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\\\\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n            return (payload, device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        do {\\\\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\\\\n                serverURL: serverURL,\\\\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\\\\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\\\\n            )\\\\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\\\\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\\\\n        } catch {\\\\n#if DEBUG\\\\n            print(\\\\\\\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\\\\\\\(requestIDs): \\\\\\\\(error)\\\\\\\")\\\\n#endif\\\\n            // Fall back to cached payload\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\\\\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\\\\n\\\\n        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {\\\\n            // Ensure the pre-rendered map image matches the freshest data we’re about to display.\\\\n            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return (payload, device)\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; [String] {\\\\n        var ordered: [String] = []\\\\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\\\\n            ordered.append(primary)\\\\n        }\\\\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\\\\n            ordered.append(additional)\\\\n        }\\\\n        return ordered\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\\\\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\\\\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\\\\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&amp;amp;gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\\\\n        var updatedPayload = payload\\\\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\\\\n\\\\n        for location in locations {\\\\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\\\\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\\\\n\\\\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\\\\n                id: location.Device,\\\\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\\\\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\\\\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\\\\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\\\\n                country: metadata?.country,\\\\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\\\\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\\\\n                color: metadata?.color\\\\n            )\\\\n\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\\\\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\\\\n\\\\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\\\\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        return updatedPayload\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n\\\"\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"plan\\\": \\\"# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\\\n\\\\n## Architecture Overview\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;mermaid\\\\nflowchart TB\\\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\\\n    end\\\\n    \\\\n    LM --&amp;amp;gt; DLC\\\\n    DLC --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    KDS --&amp;amp;gt; SD\\\\n    mainApp --&amp;amp;gt; MI\\\\n    SD --&amp;amp;gt; TP\\\\n    MI --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; TW\\\\n    TP --&amp;amp;gt; MW\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Key Implementation Details\\\\n\\\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\\\n- Create App Group: &amp;amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\\\n\\\\n**File**: &amp;amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\\\n- Include \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location for distance calculations\\\\n\\\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\\\nCreate new target: &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n**Files to create**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\\\n\\\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\\\nShows: \\\\\\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Approach**: \\\\n- Main app generates &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; images when location updates\\\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\\\n\\\\n**Supported sizes**:\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\\\n\\\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\\\n- Call &amp;amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;amp;#96; on location updates\\\\n- Trigger &amp;amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;amp;#96; after sync\\\\n\\\\n**Update** [&amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\\\n\\\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\\\n- Create &amp;amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;amp;#96; in main app\\\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;amp;#96; \\\\n- Draw &amp;amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;amp;#96; onto snapshot\\\\n- Save to App Group container\\\\n\\\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\\\n- Widget reads \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" location from shared data\\\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\\\n\\\\n## Widget Configuration\\\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;amp;#96; devices\\\\n- Excludes \\\\\\\"this device\\\\\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\\\n\\\\n## File Structure\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\nmiataru/\\\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\\\n├── views/\\\\n│   └── Common/\\\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\\\n├── Info.plist\\\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\\\n- Add WidgetKit framework dependency\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "    \"content\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-08.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MapKit\\n\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\nimport UIKit\\n#endif\\n\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a simple device marker) and writes them into\\n/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\n///\\n/// Why this exists in the widget extension:\\n/// The widget timeline can fetch fresh location data, but without regenerating the snapshot\\n/// image the map can remain stale while text updates (e.g. \\\"updated … ago\\\").\\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\n    #if canImport(UIKit)\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\n                                        size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 600, height: 600)) async {\\n        let ts = device.timestamp\\n        let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\\n\\n        // If either style is missing or older than the device timestamp, regenerate it.\\n        let needsLight = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .light, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\n        let needsDark = needsRegeneration(deviceID: device.id, style: .dark, deviceTimestamp: ts)\\n        guard needsLight || needsDark else { return }\\n\\n        if needsLight {\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .light)\\n        }\\n        if needsDark {\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .dark)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func needsRegeneration(deviceID: String, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle, deviceTimestamp: Date) -&amp;gt; Bool {\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: deviceID, style: style) else { return true }\\n        guard let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),\\n              let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else {\\n            return true\\n        }\\n        // Regenerate if the snapshot predates the data we’re about to show.\\n        return modDate &amp;lt; deviceTimestamp\\n    }\\n\\n    @MainActor\\n    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: WidgetDeviceData,\\n                                       coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\n                                       size: CGSize,\\n                                       style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id, style: style) else { return }\\n\\n        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\n        options.size = size\\n        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n        options.mapType = .standard\\n        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\n        options.showsBuildings = false\\n        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: device.accuracy)\\n        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)\\n\\n        do {\\n            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\n            let marker = markerImage(for: device, style: style)\\n            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, markerImage: marker)\\n            if let data = image.pngData() {\\n                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\n            }\\n        } catch {\\n            #if DEBUG\\n            print(\\\"[Widget] Failed to generate map snapshot (\\\\(style == .dark ? \\\"dark\\\" : \\\"light\\\")) for \\\\(device.id): \\\\(error)\\\")\\n            #endif\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\n            center: coordinate,\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\n        )\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot,\\n                               coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\\n                               size: CGSize,\\n                               markerImage: UIImage) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\n\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\n            )\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: WidgetDeviceData, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let color = uiColor(from: device.color) ?? UIColor.systemBlue\\n        let symbol = UIImage(systemName: \\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\") ?? UIImage()\\n        let tinted = symbol.withTintColor(color, renderingMode: .alwaysOriginal)\\n\\n        let target = CGSize(width: 44, height: 44)\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: target)\\n        return renderer.image { _ in\\n            let rect = CGRect(origin: .zero, size: target)\\n            tinted.draw(in: rect.insetBy(dx: 2, dy: 2))\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func uiColor(from color: WidgetColor?) -&amp;gt; UIColor? {\\n        guard let color else { return nil }\\n        return UIColor(red: color.red, green: color.green, blue: color.blue, alpha: color.alpha)\\n    }\\n    #else\\n    static func ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for device: WidgetDeviceData, size: CGSize = .zero) async { }\\n    #endif\\n}\\n\\n\","

[]\\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\\n\\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MapKit\\nimport SwiftUI\\n\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\nimport UIKit\\n#endif\\n\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker) and writes them into\\n/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\\n\\n            // Render both light and dark variants so widgets can pick based on appearance.\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .light)\\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .dark)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    @MainActor\\n    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, size: CGSize, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {\\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID, style: style) else { return }\\n\\n        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\n        options.size = size\\n        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n        options.mapType = .standard\\n        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\n        options.showsBuildings = false\\n        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)\\n        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)\\n\\n        do {\\n            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\n            let markerImage = await markerImage(for: device)\\n            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size, markerImage: markerImage)\\n            if let data = image.pngData() {\\n                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\n            }\\n        } catch {\\n            debugLog(\\\"Failed to generate widget map snapshot (\\\\(style == .dark ? \\\"dark\\\" : \\\"light\\\")): \\\\(error)\\\")\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\n            center: coordinate,\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\n        )\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\n\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\n        return renderer.image { context in\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\n\\n            // Draw marker\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\n            )\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\n\\n            // Location text overlay (locality / country + last update)\\n            let overlayText = overlayString(for: location)\\n            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()\\n            paragraph.alignment = .left\\n            let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [\\n                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13, weight: .semibold),\\n                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white,\\n                .paragraphStyle: paragraph,\\n                .shadow: textShadow()\\n            ]\\n            let textRect = CGRect(\\n                x: 8,\\n                y: size.height - 40,\\n                width: size.width - 16,\\n                height: 32\\n            )\\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        var components: [String] = []\\n        if let locality = location.locality { components.append(locality) }\\n        if let country = location.country { components.append(country) }\\n        let place = components.joined(separator: \\\", \\\")\\n\\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\\n        let relative = formatter.localizedString(for: location.timestamp, relativeTo: Date())\\n\\n        if place.isEmpty {\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\"widget_overlay_last_seen\\\", comment: \\\"Fallback overlay text when no placemark is available\\\").replacingOccurrences(of: \\\"%@\\\", with: relative)\\n        } else {\\n            return \\\"\\\\(place) • \\\\(relative)\\\"\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func textShadow() -&amp;gt; NSShadow {\\n        let shadow = NSShadow()\\n        shadow.shadowColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.6)\\n        shadow.shadowOffset = CGSize(width: 0, height: 1)\\n        shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 2\\n        return shadow\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        await MainActor.run {\\n            let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\\n                color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\\n                height: 44,\\n                cacheEnabled: false,\\n                renderPadding: 10\\n            )\\n            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\\n            renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n            renderer.isOpaque = false\\n            return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: \\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\") ?? UIImage()\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\","

)\\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; String {\\n                   "content": "  \"plan\": \"# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\n\\n## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TB\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\n    end\\n    \\n    LM --&amp;gt; DLC\\n    DLC --&amp;gt; SD\\n    KDS --&amp;gt; SD\\n    mainApp --&amp;gt; MI\\n    SD --&amp;gt; TP\\n    MI --&amp;gt; MW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; TW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; MW\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Key Implementation Details\\n\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\n- Create App Group: &amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;#96;\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\n\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:\\n\\n**File**: &amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;#96;\\n- &amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\n- &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\n- Include \\\"this device\\\" location for distance calculations\\n\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\nCreate new target: &amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;#96;\\n\\n**Files to create**:\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\n\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\nShows: \\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\"\\n\\n**Supported sizes**:\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\n- &amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\n\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay\\n\\n**Approach**: \\n- Main app generates &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; images when location updates\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\n\\n**Supported sizes**:\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\n- &amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\n\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:\\n\\n**Update** [&amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\n- Call &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;#96; on location updates\\n- Trigger &amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;#96; after sync\\n\\n**Update** [&amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;#96;](miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\n\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\n- Create &amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;#96; in main app\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; \\n- Draw &amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;#96; onto snapshot\\n- Save to App Group container\\n\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\n- Widget reads \\\"this device\\\" location from shared data\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;#96;\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\n\\n## Widget Configuration\\nUsers select which device to display via widget configuration intent:\\n- Dynamic options populated from &amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore&amp;#96; devices\\n- Excludes \\\"this device\\\" from selection (only shows other tracked devices)\\n\\n## File Structure\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nmiataru/\\n├── SettingsManagers/\\n│   └── SharedWidgetData.swift (NEW)\\n├── views/\\n│   └── Common/\\n│       └── WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift (NEW)\\nmiataruWidgets/ (NEW TARGET)\\n├── MiataruWidgets.swift\\n├── DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift\\n├── DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift\\n├── WidgetIntents.swift\\n├── Info.plist\\n└── Assets.xcassets/\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Xcode Project Changes\\n- Add Widget Extension target via Xcode\\n- Configure App Groups entitlements for both targets\\n- Add WidgetKit framework dependency\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 641,
                  "content": "    \"content\": \"---\\nname: Miataru iOS Widgets\\noverview: \\\"Add a WidgetKit extension with two widget types: a text-based location widget showing device location and distance, and a map snapshot widget showing a rendered map image. Both widgets will support multiple sizes and use App Groups for shared data access.\\\"\\ntodos:\\n  - id: shared-data\\n    content: Create SharedWidgetData.swift with Codable models and App Group file manager\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: app-group-sync\\n    content: Update DeviceLocationCacheStore and KnownDeviceStore to sync to App Group\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: map-snapshot\\n    content: Create WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator for pre-rendering map images with markers\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-extension\\n    content: Create miataruWidgets extension target with bundle entry point\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: text-widget\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationTextWidget with small, medium, and lock screen sizes\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: map-widget\\n    content: Implement DeviceLocationMapWidget with small, medium, and large sizes\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-intent\\n    content: Create device selection intent for widget configuration\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: widget-reload\\n    content: Add WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines() calls on data updates\\n    status: pending\\n---\\n\\n# Miataru iOS Widgets Implementation\\n\\n## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TB\\n    subgraph mainApp [Main App]\\n        LM[LocationManager]\\n        DLC[DeviceLocationCacheStore]\\n        KDS[KnownDeviceStore]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph shared [App Group Container]\\n        SD[SharedDeviceData.json]\\n        MI[MapSnapshot Images]\\n    end\\n    \\n    subgraph widgetExt [Widget Extension]\\n        TP[TimelineProvider]\\n        TW[TextWidget]\\n        MW[MapWidget]\\n    end\\n    \\n    LM --&amp;gt; DLC\\n    DLC --&amp;gt; SD\\n    KDS --&amp;gt; SD\\n    mainApp --&amp;gt; MI\\n    SD --&amp;gt; TP\\n    MI --&amp;gt; MW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; TW\\n    TP --&amp;gt; MW\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n\\n\\n## Key Implementation Details\\n\\n### 1. App Group Setup\\n\\n- Create App Group: &amp;#96;group.com.miataru.ios&amp;#96;\\n- Enable App Groups capability for main app target\\n- Enable App Groups capability for widget extension target\\n\\n### 2. Shared Data Layer\\n\\nCreate a new shared data model that both the main app and widget can access:**File**: &amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetData.swift&amp;#96;\\n\\n- &amp;#96;WidgetDeviceData&amp;#96; struct (Codable) containing: deviceID, deviceName, latitude, longitude, locality, country, timestamp, color\\n- &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager&amp;#96; to read/write JSON to App Group container\\n- Include \\\"this device\\\" location for distance calculations\\n\\n### 3. Widget Extension Target\\n\\nCreate new target: &amp;#96;miataruWidgets&amp;#96;**Files to create**:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/MiataruWidgets.swift&amp;#96; - Widget bundle entry point\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Text-based widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift&amp;#96; - Map snapshot widget\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/WidgetIntents.swift&amp;#96; - Device selection intent for widget configuration\\n- &amp;#96;miataruWidgets/Assets.xcassets&amp;#96; - Widget preview assets\\n\\n### 4. Text Widget (DeviceLocationTextWidget)\\n\\nShows: \\\"Device XYZ is in Locality, Country - X km away\\\"**Tap action**: &amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;#96; deep link to &amp;#96;miataru://&amp;lt;deviceID&amp;gt;&amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Device name + location + distance\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Device name + full location + distance + last update time\\n- &amp;#96;.accessoryRectangular&amp;#96; (Lock Screen) - Compact location + distance\\n\\n### 5. Map Widget (DeviceLocationMapWidget)\\n\\nShows pre-rendered map snapshot with device marker overlay**Approach**:\\n\\n- Main app generates &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; images when location updates\\n- Saves PNG to App Group container\\n- Widget displays cached image with text overlay\\n\\n**Tap action**: &amp;#96;widgetURL&amp;#96; deep link to &amp;#96;miataru://&amp;lt;deviceID&amp;gt;&amp;#96; to open that device in the app.**Supported sizes**:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;.systemSmall&amp;#96; - Map only with marker\\n- &amp;#96;.systemMedium&amp;#96; - Map with location text overlay\\n- &amp;#96;.systemLarge&amp;#96; - Map with device name, location, and timestamp\\n\\n### 6. Main App Integration\\n\\nModify existing stores to sync data to App Group:**Update** [&amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift&amp;#96;](DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift):\\n\\n- Call &amp;#96;SharedWidgetDataManager.syncDeviceLocations()&amp;#96; on location updates\\n- Trigger &amp;#96;WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()&amp;#96; after sync\\n\\n**Update** [&amp;#96;KnownDeviceStore.swift&amp;#96;](KnownDeviceStore.swift)(miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift):\\n\\n- Sync device names/colors to shared storage on changes\\n\\n**Add map snapshot generation**:\\n\\n- Create &amp;#96;WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift&amp;#96; in main app\\n- Generate snapshots using &amp;#96;MKMapSnapshotter&amp;#96; \\n- Draw &amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;#96; onto snapshot\\n- Save to App Group container\\n\\n### 7. Distance Calculation\\n\\n- Widget reads \\\"this device\\\" location from shared data\\n- Calculates distance to selected tracked device using &amp;#96;CLLocation.distance(from:)&amp;#96;\\n- Formats distance in km/miles based on locale\\n\\n### 8.                   "lineNumber": 1460,
                  "content": "    \"content\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MapKit\\nimport SwiftUI\\n\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\nimport UIKit\\n#endif\\n\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker and location text)\\n/// and writes them into the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\\n            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID) else { return }\\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\\n\\n            let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\n            options.size = size\\n            options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n            options.mapType = .standard\\n            options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\n            options.showsBuildings = false\\n            options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)\\n\\n            do {\\n                let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\n                let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size)\\n                if let data = image.pngData() {\\n                    try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\n                }\\n            } catch {\\n                debugLog(\\\"Failed to generate widget map snapshot: \\\\(error)\\\")\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\n            center: coordinate,\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\n        )\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let markerImage = markerImage(for: device)\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\n\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\n        return renderer.image { context in\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\n\\n            // Draw marker\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\n            )\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\n\\n            // Location text overlay (locality / country + last update)\\n            let overlayText = overlayString(for: location)\\n            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()\\n            paragraph.alignment = .left\\n            let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [\\n                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13, weight: .semibold),\\n                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white,\\n                .paragraphStyle: paragraph,\\n                .shadow: textShadow()\\n            ]\\n            let textRect = CGRect(\\n                x: 8,\\n                y: size.height - 40,\\n                width: size.width - 16,\\n                height: 32\\n            )\\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        var components: [String] = []\\n        if let locality = location.locality { components.append(locality) }\\n        if let country = location.country { components.append(country) }\\n        let place = components.joined(separator: \\\", \\\")\\n\\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\\n        let relative = formatter.localizedString(for: location.timestamp, relativeTo: Date())\\n\\n        if place.isEmpty {\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\"widget_overlay_last_seen\\\", comment: \\\"Fallback overlay text when no placemark is available\\\").replacingOccurrences(of: \\\"%@\\\", with: relative)\\n        } else {\\n            return \\\"\\\\(place) • \\\\(relative)\\\"\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func textShadow() -&amp;gt; NSShadow {\\n        let shadow = NSShadow()\\n        shadow.shadowColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.6)\\n        shadow.shadowOffset = CGSize(width: 0, height: 1)\\n        shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 2\\n        return shadow\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\\n            color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\\n            height: 44,\\n            cacheEnabled: false,\\n            renderPadding: 10\\n        )\\n        let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\\n        renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n        renderer.isOpaque = false\\n        return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: \\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\") ?? UIImage()\\n    }\\n}\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contentsAfterEdit\": \"/*\\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\\n *\\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\\n * miataru\\n *\\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\\n */\\n\\nimport Foundation\\nimport MapKit\\nimport SwiftUI\\n\\n#if canImport(UIKit)\\nimport UIKit\\n#endif\\n\\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker and location text)\\n/// and writes them into the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\\n            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID) else { return }\\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\\n\\n            let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\\n            options.size = size\\n            options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n            options.mapType = .standard\\n            options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\\n            options.showsBuildings = false\\n            options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)\\n\\n            do {\\n                let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\\n                let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size)\\n                if let data = image.pngData() {\\n                    try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\\n                }\\n            } catch {\\n                debugLog(\\\"Failed to generate widget map snapshot: \\\\(error)\\\")\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&amp;gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\\n            center: coordinate,\\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\\n        )\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let markerImage = markerImage(for: device)\\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\\n\\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\\n        return renderer.image { context in\\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\\n\\n            // Draw marker\\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\\n            )\\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\\n\\n            // Location text overlay (locality / country + last update)\\n            let overlayText = overlayString(for: location)\\n            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()\\n            paragraph.alignment = .left\\n            let attrs: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [\\n                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 13, weight: .semibold),\\n                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white,\\n                .paragraphStyle: paragraph,\\n                .shadow: textShadow()\\n            ]\\n            let textRect = CGRect(\\n                x: 8,\\n                y: size.height - 40,\\n                width: size.width - 16,\\n                height: 32\\n            )\\n            overlayText.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attrs)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func overlayString(for location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&amp;gt; String {\\n        var components: [String] = []\\n        if let locality = location.locality { components.append(locality) }\\n        if let country = location.country { components.append(country) }\\n        let place = components.joined(separator: \\\", \\\")\\n\\n        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()\\n        formatter.unitsStyle = .short\\n        let relative = formatter.localizedString(for: location.timestamp, relativeTo: Date())\\n\\n        if place.isEmpty {\\n            return NSLocalizedString(\\\"widget_overlay_last_seen\\\", comment: \\\"Fallback overlay text when no placemark is available\\\").replacingOccurrences(of: \\\"%@\\\", with: relative)\\n        } else {\\n            return \\\"\\\\(place) • \\\\(relative)\\\"\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func textShadow() -&amp;gt; NSShadow {\\n        let shadow = NSShadow()\\n        shadow.shadowColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.6)\\n        shadow.shadowOffset = CGSize(width: 0, height: 1)\\n        shadow.shadowBlurRadius = 2\\n        return shadow\\n    }\\n\\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) -&amp;gt; UIImage {\\n        let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\\n            color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\\n            height: 44,\\n            cacheEnabled: false,\\n            renderPadding: 10\\n        )\\n        let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\\n        renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\\n        renderer.isOpaque = false\\n        return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: \\\"mappin.circle.fill\\\") ?? UIImage()\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n\""

loc.locality == nil) || loc.timeZone == nil {\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: loc.deviceID)\\n        }\\n    }\\n    \\n    private func save() {\\n        do {\\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: locations, requiringSecureCoding: true)\\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\\n        } catch {\\n            debugLog(\\\"Error saving device locations: \\\\(error)\\\")\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private func load() -&amp;gt; [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\\n        do {\\n            if let locations = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, CachedDeviceLocation.self, NSDate.self, NSString.self], from: data) as? [CachedDeviceLocation] {\\n                return locations\\n            }\\n        } catch {\\n            debugLog(\\\"Error loading device locations: \\\\(error)\\\")\\n            // Remove incompatible cache file to prevent repeated load failures\\n            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)\\n        }\\n        return []\\n    }\\n\\n    func setLocation(for deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\\n        var snapshotLocation: CachedDeviceLocation?\\n\\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\\n            let existing = locations[idx]\\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\\n                deviceID: deviceID,\\n                latitude: latitude,\\n                longitude: longitude,\\n                accuracy: accuracy,\\n                timestamp: timestamp,\\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\\n                country: existing.country,\\n                locality: existing.locality,\\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\\n                altitude: altitude,\\n                speed: speed ?? existing.speed\\n            )\\n            locations[idx] = updated\\n            snapshotLocation = updated\\n            if moved {\\n                // Re-geocode only on significant movement or if no placemark exists yet\\n                let hasPlacemark = (existing.country != nil) || (existing.locality != nil)\\n                let oldLoc = CLLocation(latitude: existing.latitude, longitude: existing.longitude)\\n                let newLoc = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)\\n                let distance = oldLoc.distance(from: newLoc)\\n                if !hasPlacemark || distance &amp;gt;= geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters {\\n                    enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID, force: true)\\n                }\\n            }\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\n        } else {\\n            let newLocation = CachedDeviceLocation(deviceID: deviceID, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: accuracy, timestamp: timestamp, batteryLevel: batteryLevel, altitude: altitude, speed: speed)\\n            locations.append(newLocation)\\n            snapshotLocation = newLocation\\n            // New entry: if no placemark present, enqueue\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID)\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\n        }\\n\\n        if let location = snapshotLocation,\\n           let device = KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\\n            WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.generateSnapshot(for: device, location: location)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    func getLocation(for deviceID: String) -&amp;gt; CachedDeviceLocation? {\\n        return locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID })\\n    }\\n\\n    func getPlacemark(for deviceID: String) -&amp;gt; (country: String?, locality: String?)? {\\n        guard let loc = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) else { return nil }\\n        return (loc.country, loc.locality)\\n    }\\n\\n    func setPlacemark(for deviceID: String, country: String?, locality: String?, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil) {\\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\\n            let loc = locations[idx]\\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\\n                deviceID: loc.deviceID,\\n                latitude: loc.latitude,\\n                longitude: loc.longitude,\\n                accuracy: loc.accuracy,\\n                timestamp: loc.timestamp,\\n                country: country,\\n                locality: locality,\\n                timeZone: timeZone ?? loc.timeZone,\\n                batteryLevel: loc.batteryLevel,\\n                altitude: loc.altitude\\n            )\\n            locations[idx] = updated\\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\n        }\\n    }\\n    \\n    func removeLocation(for deviceID: String) {\\n        locations.removeAll { $0.deviceID == deviceID }\\n        WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\\n    }\\n\\n    // MARK: - Reverse Geocoding Queue\\n    func enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for deviceID: String, force: Bool = false) {\\n        // If not forced and placemark already present with timezone, skip\\n        if !force {\\n            if let location = getLocation(for: deviceID),\\n               let placemark = getPlacemark(for: deviceID),\\n               (placemark.country != nil || placemark.locality != nil),\\n               location.timeZone != nil {\\n                return\\n            }\\n        }\\n        guard let _ = getLocation(for: deviceID) else { return }\\n        // Avoid duplicates in queue\\n        if !geocodeQueue.contains(deviceID) {\\n            geocodeQueue.append(deviceID)\\n        }\\n        processNextGeocode()\\n    }\\n    \\n    func getTimeZone(for deviceID: String) -&amp;gt; TimeZone? {\\n        return getLocation(for: deviceID)?.timeZone\\n    }\\n    \\n    func forceGeocodingForAllDevices() {\\n        for location in locations {\\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: location.deviceID, force: true)\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private func processNextGeocode() {\\n        guard !isProcessingGeocode else { return }\\n        guard !geocodeQueue.isEmpty else { return }\\n        isProcessingGeocode = true\\n        let nextDeviceID = geocodeQueue.removeFirst()\\n        guard let cached = getLocation(for: nextDeviceID) else {\\n            isProcessingGeocode = false\\n            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.2) { [weak self] in\\n                self?.processNextGeocode()\\n            }\\n            return\\n        }\\n        let location = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\\n        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in\\n            guard let self = self else { return }\\n            let pm = placemarks?.first\\n            DispatchQueue.main.async {\\n                if let pm = pm {\\n                    let country = pm.country\\n                    let locality = pm.locality ?? pm.subAdministrativeArea ?? pm.administrativeArea\\n                    let timeZone = pm.timeZone\\n                    self.setPlacemark(for: nextDeviceID, country: country, locality: locality, timeZone: timeZone)\\n                }\\n                self.isProcessingGeocode = false\\n                // Be polite with geocoder\\n                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) {\\n                    self.processNextGeocode()\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n} \\n\","

### Deep analysis (what’s likely going wrong)

- **The widget *does* have a refresh schedule**: both text + map widgets ask WidgetKit for a new timeline entry every ~15 minutes (`policy: .after(next)`).
- **Only the map widget was doing heavy work during timeline generation**: it called `loadEntryData(... generateMapSnapshots: true)` which (previously) *awaited* map snapshot rendering. Map snapshot rendering uses `MKMapSnapshotter` + `UIGraphicsImageRenderer` and is easy to blow WidgetKit’s tight execution budget with (especially on cold start / background refresh). When WidgetKit kills/aborts timeline generation, you get the classic symptom: **the widget looks frozen and only “jumps” when the app opens and calls `WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines()`**.
- **There’s also a subtle “infinite stale” trap**: snapshot staleness was compared against `device.timestamp`. If server timestamps are ahead of device time (clock skew), the widget can think snapshots are *always* stale and keep trying to regenerate them.

### What I changed to fix “frozen until app opens”

#### 1) Don’t block timeline generation on snapshot rendering
I made snapshot generation **best-effort in the background** instead of awaited during timeline building:

```15:69:miataruWidgets/WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift
if generateMapSnapshots, let device {
    // Generating MKMapSnapshotter images can be slow and may exceed WidgetKit's
    // tight execution budget if awaited during timeline generation.
    // Do it best-effort in the background and let the provider schedule a near-term
    // refresh if it detects stale/missing snapshots.
    Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
        await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)
    }
}
```

#### 2) If snapshots are stale/missing, request a near-term retry (2 minutes)
So the map widget can recover quickly (and pick up the newly generated PNG) without waiting the full 15 minutes:

```41:88:miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift
var next = ... 15 minutes ...

if let device = entry.device, needsSnapshotRefresh(for: device) {
    next = ... 2 minutes ...
}
return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
```

#### 3) Clamp “staleness timestamp” to now to avoid endless regen on clock skew
I fixed the snapshot staleness logic in the generator:

```44:54:miataruWidgets/WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift
let referenceTimestamp = min(deviceTimestamp, Date())
return modDate < referenceTimestamp
```

### Notes / how this matches your symptom
- If the timeline refresh was being killed due to snapshot work, **WidgetKit would keep showing the previous entry** until something external (like the app opening) triggers a reload — exactly what you observed.
- With the changes above, timeline generation stays lightweight, and the widget “self-heals” by retrying soon when the snapshot file isn’t ready yet.

If you tell me whether the **text widget** also freezes or only the **map widget**, I can narrow this further—but this change directly targets the only map-specific blocking work path.
